summary: Completed revision 3's remaining consumer documentation and release surface. Verified and finished the additive Version 1.9.0 note in documentation/breaking-changes.md (with its previous/next links kept), the 1.9.0 bump in package.json and both root package-lock entries, and the updated toggle release assertion. Tightened README's sheenTrigger example so it actually changes the value, and corrected the guide's wording so it no longer claims the feature adds no hook or state. README, API reference, features, examples, configuration, development and the focus-streak guide document focusSheen (default false) and sheenTrigger (string | number, first value on mount plays nothing, works with or without focusSheen, no reduced-motion override). Added/kept the R10, R13, R12 and R11 guard tests: the streak is click-through, visually inset with no size/spacing rules, identical in accessible name/role/state, adds no DOM, listeners, timers or observers across 100 buttons, and stops when unmounted. Build, type check and the full Jest suite (31 suites, 404 tests, 99.64% line coverage) pass.
